title: THE AIR STRIKE PLATE MOVES TO THE RIGHT
why: His playtest note of 2026-10-14: the air strike bar is in a weird place and causes collisions, it should be over on the right further. The plate sat just right of the middle of the screen, a little over the gun bar, where the power-up timer chips, the item you are readying and the bar own hover and ammo text all live, so they ran into it. It now sits at the right end of the gun bar, one chip row up, past the chips and the item in hand and clear of the keys; the corner gun card starts at the end of the bar so there is no room beside it, and if the plate would ever meet the gear card, the pickup stack, the pickup gun card or the kill feed it lifts clear above them. The same plate is drawn by the same code in both windows of a two player game, each with its own meter.
now: The air strike meter now sits over on the right of the gun bar, out of the way of the power-up timers.
